title: Revised foundations bring pleasure in clarity

captions.emotions: Enjoying an understandable connection found together

meaning: Releasing an unstable conclusion can develop understanding through details and bring pleasure in a connection discovered together.
text: Pleasure in clarity sometimes follows an uncomfortable revision. The Tower in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly releasing a conclusion whose foundation proved unstable. The Empress in energy supports understanding’s development through particulars. The Sun in emotions enjoys an understandable connection found together. A convenient account can remain dear although fresh material no longer fits. Attention to that material preserves the possibility of a substantial continuation for both people.

Suppose you explained old objects’ appeal solely through memories. Examining an unfamiliar cup both people like, you stop treating that cause as sufficient. **Revising foundations can reveal pleasure in more precise understanding.** Care for thought’s development reveals form and signs of use. Another observation enriches the question. Understanding several actual foundations for interest feels pleasing. Memory, convenience and an object’s visible history can be discussed while each detail gains a place. Your view becomes clearer, preserving personal differences and each example’s freedom to contradict the initial account.

The risk is immediately declaring form a universal answer in place of memory because fresh understanding feels pleasing. Wanting thought to develop preserves material’s variety. One conclusion proved insufficient while observations retain value. Clarity need not acquire another all-encompassing foundation. Your view can hold several understandable connections while every case retains its relationship between what you see, know and experience personally.
